  · simp only [z, neg_neg]

/-! ## Full finite-basis exactness -/

variable {ι : Type v} [Fintype ι]

/-- Divisor-section form of the basepoint-free pencil reduction. -/
theorem Scheme.ker_finiteMulMap_eq_range_finiteMulKoszulBoundary_of_divisor_pencil
    (U : Submodule K X.functionField) (b : Module.Basis ι K U)
    (A B : X.CurveDivisor) (w : X.functionFieldˣ)
    (hone : (1 : X.functionField) ∈ U) (hw : (w : X.functionField) ∈ U)
    (hmul : ∀ (i : ι) (z : divisorSections K B ⊤),
      (b i : X.functionField) * (z : X.functionField) ∈ divisorSections K A ⊤)
    (hsup : B ⊔
        (B - Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) w) = A)
    (hinfEq : A ⊓
        (A + Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) w) = B)
    (hB : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (X.divisorSheaf K B) 1))
    (hBw : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (X.divisorSheaf K
      (B - Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) w)) 1))
    (hinf : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (X.divisorSheaf K
      (B ⊓ (B - Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) w))) 1))
    (hsupH : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (X.divisorSheaf K
      (B ⊔ (B - Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) w))) 1)) :
    LinearMap.ker (Scheme.finiteMulMap U (divisorSections K A ⊤) b) =
      LinearMap.range (Scheme.finiteMulKoszulBoundary U
        (divisorSections K B ⊤) (divisorSections K A ⊤) b hmul) := by
  let a : Fin 2 → U := fun q => if q = 0 then ⟨1, hone⟩ else ⟨w, hw⟩
  apply Scheme.ker_finiteMulMap_eq_range_finiteMulKoszulBoundary_of_pencil
    U (divisorSections K B ⊤) (divisorSections K A ⊤) b hmul a
  · intro x
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_divisorSections_pencil_decomposition
      A B w hsup hB hBw hinf hsupH x
    refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
    simpa [a, Fin.sum_univ_two] using hz
  · intro y hy
    have hy' : (y 0 : X.functionField) +
        (w : X.functionField) * (y 1 : X.functionField) = 0 := by
      simpa [a, Fin.sum_univ_two] using hy
    obtain ⟨z, hz0, hz1⟩ := exists_divisorSections_pencil_relation A B w hinfEq y hy'
    exact ⟨z, by simpa [a] using hz0, by simpa [a] using hz1⟩

/-! ## An arbitrary basepoint-free pair -/

/-- Two arbitrary nonzero rational sections span a divisor window when their
translated source divisors have the required supremum. -/
theorem exists_divisorSections_pair_decomposition
    (A B : X.CurveDivisor) (v0 v1 : X.functionFieldˣ)
    (hsup : (B - Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v0) ⊔
        (B - Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v1) = A)
    (h0 : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (X.divisorSheaf K
      (B - Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v0)) 1))
    (h1 : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (X.divisorSheaf K
      (B - Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v1)) 1))
    (hinf : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (X.divisorSheaf K
      ((B - Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v0) ⊓
        (B - Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v1))) 1))
    (hsupH : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (X.divisorSheaf K
      ((B - Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v0) ⊔
        (B - Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v1))) 1))
    (x : divisorSections K A ⊤) :
    ∃ z : Fin 2 → divisorSections K B ⊤,
      (x : X.functionField) =
        (v0 : X.functionField) * (z 0 : X.functionField) +
          (v1 : X.functionField) * (z 1 : X.functionField) := by
  let D0 := Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v0
  let D1 := Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v1
  have hmap0 : Submodule.map (Scheme.mulLinear K (v0 : X.functionField))
      (divisorSections K B ⊤) = divisorSections K (B - D0) ⊤ := by
    rw [map_mulLinear_divisorSections_top K (Units.ne_zero v0) B]
    have hmk : Units.mk0 (v0 : X.functionField) (Units.ne_zero v0) = v0 := Units.ext rfl
    rw [hmk]
  have hmap1 : Submodule.map (Scheme.mulLinear K (v1 : X.functionField))
      (divisorSections K B ⊤) = divisorSections K (B - D1) ⊤ := by
    rw [map_mulLinear_divisorSections_top K (Units.ne_zero v1) B]
    have hmk : Units.mk0 (v1 : X.functionField) (Units.ne_zero v1) = v1 := Units.ext rfl
    rw [hmk]
  have hsections :
      Submodule.map (Scheme.mulLinear K (v0 : X.functionField))
          (divisorSections K B ⊤) ⊔
        Submodule.map (Scheme.mulLinear K (v1 : X.functionField))
          (divisorSections K B ⊤) = divisorSections K A ⊤ := by
    rw [hmap0, hmap1, divisorSections_sup K (B - D0) (B - D1) h0 h1 hinf hsupH,
      hsup]
  have hx : (x : X.functionField) ∈
      Submodule.map (Scheme.mulLinear K (v0 : X.functionField))
          (divisorSections K B ⊤) ⊔
        Submodule.map (Scheme.mulLinear K (v1 : X.functionField))
          (divisorSections K B ⊤) := by
    rw [hsections]
    exact x.property
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hab⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hx
  obtain ⟨z0, hz0, rfl⟩ := ha
  obtain ⟨z1, hz1, rfl⟩ := hb
  let z : Fin 2 → divisorSections K B ⊤ := fun q =>
    if q = 0 then ⟨z0, hz0⟩ else ⟨z1, hz1⟩
  refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
  simpa [z, Scheme.mulLinear_apply] using hab.symm

omit [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (X.moduleKSheaf K) 0)]
  [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (X.moduleKSheaf K) 1)] in
private theorem mem_divisorSections_add_divOf_of_mul_mem
    (A : X.CurveDivisor) (v : X.functionFieldˣ) (z : X.functionField)
    (hz : (v : X.functionField) * z ∈ divisorSections K A ⊤) :
    z ∈ divisorSections K
      (A + Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v) ⊤ := by
  let D := Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v
  have hmap : Submodule.map (Scheme.mulLinear K (v : X.functionField))
      (divisorSections K (A + D) ⊤) = divisorSections K A ⊤ := by
    rw [map_mulLinear_divisorSections_top K (Units.ne_zero v)]
    have hmk : Units.mk0 (v : X.functionField) (Units.ne_zero v) = v := Units.ext rfl
    rw [hmk]
    change divisorSections K (A + D - D) ⊤ = divisorSections K A ⊤
    congr 2
    abel
  have hzmap : (v : X.functionField) * z ∈
      Submodule.map (Scheme.mulLinear K (v : X.functionField))
        (divisorSections K (A + D) ⊤) := by
    rw [hmap]
    exact hz
  obtain ⟨t, ht, htz⟩ := hzmap
  have : t = z := by
    change (v : X.functionField) * t = (v : X.functionField) * z at htz
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ (Units.ne_zero v) htz
  rwa [this] at ht

omit [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (X.moduleKSheaf K) 0)]
  [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (X.moduleKSheaf K) 1)] in
/-- The two-term relation of arbitrary nonzero rational sections is generated
from the intersection of their translated target divisors. -/
theorem exists_divisorSections_pair_relation
    (A B : X.CurveDivisor) (v0 v1 : X.functionFieldˣ)
    (hinf : (A + Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v0) ⊓
        (A + Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v1) = B)
    (y : Fin 2 → divisorSections K A ⊤)
    (hy : (v0 : X.functionField) * (y 0 : X.functionField) +
      (v1 : X.functionField) * (y 1 : X.functionField) = 0) :
    ∃ z : divisorSections K B ⊤,
      (y 0 : X.functionField) = (v1 : X.functionField) * (z : X.functionField) ∧
      (y 1 : X.functionField) = -(v0 : X.functionField) * (z : X.functionField) := by
  let z0 : X.functionField := (v1⁻¹ : X.functionFieldˣ) * (y 0 : X.functionField)
  have hv1z : (v1 : X.functionField) * z0 = (y 0 : X.functionField) := by
    simp only [z0, Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val]
    field_simp
  have hv0z : (v0 : X.functionField) * z0 = -(y 1 : X.functionField) := by
    simp only [z0, Units.val_inv_eq_inv_val]
    have hv1 : (v1 : X.functionField) ≠ 0 := Units.ne_zero v1
    field_simp
    linear_combination hy
  have hz0 : z0 ∈ divisorSections K
      (A + Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v0) ⊤ :=
    mem_divisorSections_add_divOf_of_mul_mem A v0 z0 (by
      rw [hv0z]
      exact (divisorSections K A ⊤).neg_mem (y 1).property)
  have hz1 : z0 ∈ divisorSections K
      (A + Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v1) ⊤ :=
    mem_divisorSections_add_divOf_of_mul_mem A v1 z0 (by
      rw [hv1z]
      exact (y 0).property)
  have hzB : z0 ∈ divisorSections K B ⊤ := by
    have hz : z0 ∈
        divisorSections K (A + Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v0) ⊤ ⊓
          divisorSections K (A + Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v1) ⊤ :=
      Submodule.mem_inf.mpr ⟨hz0, hz1⟩
    rw [divisorSections_inf K, hinf] at hz
    exact hz
  refine ⟨⟨z0, hzB⟩, hv1z.symm, ?_⟩
  change (y 1 : X.functionField) = -(v0 : X.functionField) * z0
  linear_combination hv0z

/-- Full finite-basis exactness from an arbitrary basepoint-free divisor pair. -/
theorem Scheme.ker_finiteMulMap_eq_range_finiteMulKoszulBoundary_of_divisor_pair
    (U : Submodule K X.functionField) (b : Module.Basis ι K U)
    (A B : X.CurveDivisor) (v0 v1 : X.functionFieldˣ)
    (hv0 : (v0 : X.functionField) ∈ U) (hv1 : (v1 : X.functionField) ∈ U)
    (hmul : ∀ (i : ι) (z : divisorSections K B ⊤),
      (b i : X.functionField) * (z : X.functionField) ∈ divisorSections K A ⊤)
    (hsup : (B - Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v0) ⊔
        (B - Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v1) = A)
    (hinfEq : (A + Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v0) ⊓
        (A + Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v1) = B)
    (h0 : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (X.divisorSheaf K
      (B - Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v0)) 1))
    (h1 : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (X.divisorSheaf K
      (B - Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v1)) 1))
    (hinf : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (X.divisorSheaf K
      ((B - Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v0) ⊓
        (B - Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v1))) 1))
    (hsupH : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (X.divisorSheaf K
      ((B - Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v0) ⊔
        (B - Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v1))) 1)) :
    LinearMap.ker (Scheme.finiteMulMap U (divisorSections K A ⊤) b) =
      LinearMap.range (Scheme.finiteMulKoszulBoundary U
        (divisorSections K B ⊤) (divisorSections K A ⊤) b hmul) := by
  let a : Fin 2 → U := fun q => if q = 0 then ⟨v0, hv0⟩ else ⟨v1, hv1⟩
  apply Scheme.ker_finiteMulMap_eq_range_finiteMulKoszulBoundary_of_pencil
    U (divisorSections K B ⊤) (divisorSections K A ⊤) b hmul a
  · intro x
    obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := exists_divisorSections_pair_decomposition
      A B v0 v1 hsup h0 h1 hinf hsupH x
    refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
    simpa [a, Fin.sum_univ_two] using hz
  · intro y hy
    have hy' : (v0 : X.functionField) * (y 0 : X.functionField) +
        (v1 : X.functionField) * (y 1 : X.functionField) = 0 := by
      simpa [a, Fin.sum_univ_two] using hy
    obtain ⟨z, hz0, hz1⟩ := exists_divisorSections_pair_relation
      A B v0 v1 hinfEq y hy'
    exact ⟨z, by simpa [a] using hz0, by simpa [a] using hz1⟩

/-!
# The two-coordinate recurrence in a field window

For `F = fiberWeilDivisor pi` and `u = fiberCoordUnit pi`, the two sections
`1` and `u⁻¹` of `O(F)` generate every sufficiently large window:

`H⁰(O((m + 1)F)) = H⁰(O(mF)) + u⁻¹ H⁰(O(mF))`.

The proof is the divisor-section form of the standard two-chart argument.  The
two shifted divisors are `mF` and `mF - div(u⁻¹)`; their supremum is
`(m + 1)F`, while the degree of their infimum is `(m - 1) deg(F)`.  Thus the
four `H¹` hypotheses needed by `divisorSections_sup` are discharged by the
window ledger as soon as `windowS ≤ m`.

The final pair theorem records the same recurrence through the existing field
theta presentation `thetaSectionPair`.  It is intentionally stated over a
field curve; residue-field specialisations can instantiate it without any
relative nilpotent-base assertion.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option quotPrecheck false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 4
set_option maxRecDepth 6000
set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

open Scheme

attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
  Scheme.functionFieldOverModule

section CoordinateRecurrence

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi] [IsDominant pi]

noncomputable local instance instOverCleftThetaCoordinateRecurrence :
    C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩

variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsIntegral C.left]
  [LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))]
  [QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))]
variable [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0)]
  [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1)]
variable (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))

local notation "F" => fiberWeilDivisor pi
local notation "u" => fiberCoordUnit pi
local notation "H" n => ↥(divisorSections k (n • F) ⊤)

/-! ## Small coefficient helpers -/

private lemma coeffAt_nsmul (n : Nat) (D : C.left.CurveDivisor) {x : C.left}
    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint C.left) :
    coeffAt hx (n • D) = (n : Int) * coeffAt hx D := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [succ_nsmul, CurveDivisor.coeffAt_add, ih, Nat.cast_succ]
      ring

private lemma coeffAt_divOf_inv (v : C.left.functionFieldˣ) {x : C.left}
    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint C.left) :
    coeffAt hx (Scheme.divOf (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) v⁻¹) =
      -coeffAt hx (Scheme.divOf (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) v) := by
  have h : Scheme.divOf (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) v⁻¹ +
      Scheme.divOf (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) v = 0 := by
    rw [← Scheme.divOf_mul, inv_mul_cancel, Scheme.divOf_one]
  have hc := congrArg (coeffAt hx) h
  rw [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_add, CurveDivisor.coeffAt_zero] at hc
  linarith

/-! ## The two canonical field-window generators -/

/-- The field-window representative of `(t₀, 1)`. -/
noncomputable def thetaCoordinateFstOne
    (_hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) : H 1 :=
  ⟨1, by
    simpa only [one_smul] using
      (one_mem_divisorSections_top k (fiberWeilDivisor_nonneg pi))⟩

private theorem fiberCoordUnit_inv_mem_divisorSections :
    (((u⁻¹ : C.left.functionFieldˣ) : C.left.functionField)) ∈
      divisorSections k (1 • F) ⊤ := by
  let v : C.left.functionFieldˣ := u⁻¹
  change (v : C.left.functionField) ∈ divisorSections k (1 • F) ⊤
  rw [mem_divisorSections_top_iff k (Units.ne_zero v)]
  refine CurveDivisor.le_iff_coeffAt.mpr (fun x hx => ?_)
  have hmk : Units.mk0 (v : C.left.functionField) (Units.ne_zero v) = v :=
    Units.ext rfl
  rw [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_zero, hmk, CurveDivisor.coeffAt_add, coeffAt_nsmul,
    fiberWeilDivisor_coeffAt pi, coeffAt_divOf_inv]
  have hleft : coeffAt hx
      (Scheme.divOf (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) u) ≤
      max (coeffAt hx (Scheme.divOf
        (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) u)) 0 := le_max_left _ _
  norm_num

/-- The field-window representative of `(1, t₁)`: the inverse of the fibre unit. -/
noncomputable def thetaCoordinateSndOne
    (_hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) : H 1 :=
  ⟨((u⁻¹ : C.left.functionFieldˣ) : C.left.functionField),
    fiberCoordUnit_inv_mem_divisorSections (C := C) pi⟩

@[simp]
theorem thetaCoordinateFstOne_coe :
    ((thetaCoordinateFstOne (C := C) pi hpi : H 1) : C.left.functionField) = 1 := rfl

@[simp]
theorem thetaCoordinateSndOne_coe :
    ((thetaCoordinateSndOne (C := C) pi hpi : H 1) : C.left.functionField) =
      ((u⁻¹ : C.left.functionFieldˣ) : C.left.functionField) := rfl

noncomputable def thetaCoordinateSndDivisor (m : Nat) : C.left.CurveDivisor :=
  m • F - Scheme.divOf (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (u⁻¹)

/-! ## Divisor arithmetic behind the recurrence -/

set_option maxHeartbeats 800000 in
-- The coefficientwise max/subtraction normalization is nonlinear in the order value.
theorem thetaCoordinate_sup (m : Nat) :
    (m • F) ⊔ thetaCoordinateSndDivisor (C := C) pi m = (1 + m) • F := by
  refine CurveDivisor.ext_coeffAt (fun x hx => ?_)
  rw [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_sup, thetaCoordinateSndDivisor,
    CurveDivisor.coeffAt_sub]
  simp only [coeffAt_nsmul, fiberWeilDivisor_coeffAt, coeffAt_divOf_inv]
  by_cases hd : coeffAt hx (Scheme.divOf (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) u) ≤ 0
  · have hmax : max (coeffAt hx (Scheme.divOf
        (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) u)) 0 = 0 := max_eq_right hd
    simp only [hmax]
    have hcomp : (m : Int) * 0 - -coeffAt hx
        (Scheme.divOf (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) u) ≤ (m : Int) * 0 := by
      simpa using hd
    rw [max_eq_left hcomp]
    norm_num
  · have hd' : 0 ≤ coeffAt hx
        (Scheme.divOf (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) u) :=
      le_of_lt (lt_of_not_ge hd)
    have hmax : max (coeffAt hx (Scheme.divOf
        (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) u)) 0 =
        coeffAt hx (Scheme.divOf (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) u) :=
      max_eq_left hd'
    simp only [hmax]
    have hcomp : (m : Int) * coeffAt hx
          (Scheme.divOf (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) u) ≤
        (m : Int) * coeffAt hx
          (Scheme.divOf (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) u) - -
          coeffAt hx (Scheme.divOf (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) u) := by
      nlinarith [Int.natCast_nonneg m, hd']
    rw [max_eq_right hcomp]
    push_cast
    ring

theorem thetaCoordinateSndDivisor_deg (m : Nat) :
    CurveDivisor.deg k (thetaCoordinateSndDivisor (C := C) pi m) =
      (m : Int) * windowδ pi := by
  rw [thetaCoordinateSndDivisor, Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_sub' k,
    Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_nsmul' k, deg_fiberWeilDivisor_windowδ,
    deg_divOf k, sub_zero]

private theorem thetaCoordinate_window_h1 (g m : Nat) (hm : windowS_choice pi hpi g ≤ m) :
    (Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.divisorSheaf k (m • F)) 1) ∧
      Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
        (C.left.divisorSheaf k (thetaCoordinateSndDivisor (C := C) pi m)) 1) ∧
      Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
        (C.left.divisorSheaf k ((m • F) ⊓
          thetaCoordinateSndDivisor (C := C) pi m)) 1) ∧
      Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
        (C.left.divisorSheaf k ((m • F) ⊔
          thetaCoordinateSndDivisor (C := C) pi m)) 1)) := by
  have hδ : 0 ≤ windowδ pi := windowδ_nonneg pi
  have hS : windowBound pi hpi + 2 * (g : Int) ≤
      ((windowS_choice pi hpi g : Int) - 1) * windowδ pi :=
    windowS_spec pi hpi g
  have hm' : (windowS_choice pi hpi g : Int) ≤ (m : Int) := by
    exact_mod_cast hm
  have hb0 : windowBound pi hpi ≤ (m : Int) * windowδ pi := by
    have hs0 : (windowS_choice pi hpi g : Int) * windowδ pi ≤
        (m : Int) * windowδ pi := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hm' hδ
    have := windowBound_le_S_mul pi hpi g
    linarith
  have hb1 : windowBound pi hpi ≤
      CurveDivisor.deg k (thetaCoordinateSndDivisor (C := C) pi m) := by
    rw [thetaCoordinateSndDivisor_deg]
    exact hb0
  have hsupdeg : CurveDivisor.deg k ((m • F) ⊔
      thetaCoordinateSndDivisor (C := C) pi m) =
      ((1 + m : Nat) : Int) * windowδ pi := by
    rw [thetaCoordinate_sup, Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_nsmul' k,
      deg_fiberWeilDivisor_windowδ]
  have hinfdeg : CurveDivisor.deg k ((m • F) ⊓
      thetaCoordinateSndDivisor (C := C) pi m) =
      ((m : Int) - 1) * windowδ pi := by
    have hbal := Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_inf_add_deg_sup k (m • F)
      (thetaCoordinateSndDivisor (C := C) pi m)
    rw [Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_nsmul' k, deg_fiberWeilDivisor_windowδ,
      thetaCoordinateSndDivisor_deg, hsupdeg] at hbal
    push_cast at hbal ⊢
    nlinarith [hbal]
  have hbinf : windowBound pi hpi ≤
      CurveDivisor.deg k ((m • F) ⊓
        thetaCoordinateSndDivisor (C := C) pi m) := by
    rw [hinfdeg]
    have hm1 : ((windowS_choice pi hpi g : Int) - 1) * windowδ pi ≤
        ((m : Int) - 1) * windowδ pi := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith [hm']) hδ
    linarith
  have hbsup : windowBound pi hpi ≤
      CurveDivisor.deg k ((m • F) ⊔ thetaCoordinateSndDivisor (C := C) pi m) := by
    rw [hsupdeg]
    have hmono : (m : Int) * windowδ pi ≤
        ((1 + m : Nat) : Int) * windowδ pi := by
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by omega) hδ
    linarith
  exact ⟨(by
      apply windowBound_spec pi hpi _
      rw [Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_nsmul' k, deg_fiberWeilDivisor_windowδ]
      exact hb0),
    windowBound_spec pi hpi _ hb1,
    windowBound_spec pi hpi _ hbinf,
    windowBound_spec pi hpi _ hbsup⟩

/-! ## The field-window span and elementwise recurrence -/

set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000 in
-- Rewriting both principal-divisor images and the dependent lattice supremum is expensive.
theorem thetaCoordinate_window_span (g m : Nat)
    (hm : windowS_choice pi hpi g ≤ m) :
    Submodule.map (Scheme.mulLinear k (1 : C.left.functionField))
        (divisorSections k (m • F) ⊤) ⊔
      Submodule.map (Scheme.mulLinear k
        ((u⁻¹ : C.left.functionFieldˣ) : C.left.functionField))
        (divisorSections k (m • F) ⊤) =
      divisorSections k ((1 + m) • F) ⊤ := by
  have hwin := thetaCoordinate_window_h1 (C := C) pi hpi g m hm
  have hfst := map_mulLinear_divisorSections_top k (f := (1 : C.left.functionField))
    one_ne_zero (m • F)
  have hsnd := map_mulLinear_divisorSections_top k
    (f := ((u⁻¹ : C.left.functionFieldˣ) : C.left.functionField))
    (Units.ne_zero (u⁻¹)) (m • F)
  have hmk1 : Units.mk0 (1 : C.left.functionField) one_ne_zero = 1 :=
    Units.ext rfl
  have hmk : Units.mk0 ((u⁻¹ : C.left.functionFieldˣ) : C.left.functionField)
      (Units.ne_zero (u⁻¹)) = u⁻¹ := Units.ext rfl
  rw [hfst, hsnd, hmk1, Scheme.divOf_one, sub_zero, hmk]
  calc
    divisorSections k (m • F) ⊤ ⊔
        divisorSections k (thetaCoordinateSndDivisor (C := C) pi m) ⊤ =
      divisorSections k ((m • F) ⊔
        thetaCoordinateSndDivisor (C := C) pi m) ⊤ :=
      divisorSections_sup k (m • F)
        (thetaCoordinateSndDivisor (C := C) pi m)
        hwin.1 hwin.2.1 hwin.2.2.1 hwin.2.2.2
    _ = divisorSections k ((1 + m) • F) ⊤ := by
      rw [thetaCoordinate_sup]

theorem exists_thetaCoordinate_decomposition (g m : Nat)
    (hm : windowS_choice pi hpi g ≤ m) (h : H(1 + m)) :
    ∃ z₀ z₁ : H m,
      h = thetaWindowMul (C := C) (pi := pi) 1 m
          (thetaCoordinateFstOne (C := C) pi hpi) z₀ +
        thetaWindowMul (C := C) (pi := pi) 1 m
          (thetaCoordinateSndOne (C := C) pi hpi) z₁ := by
  have hspan := thetaCoordinate_window_span (C := C) pi hpi g m hm
  have hh : (h : C.left.functionField) ∈
      Submodule.map (Scheme.mulLinear k (1 : C.left.functionField))
          (divisorSections k (m • F) ⊤) ⊔
        Submodule.map (Scheme.mulLinear k
          ((u⁻¹ : C.left.functionFieldˣ) : C.left.functionField))
          (divisorSections k (m • F) ⊤) := by
    rw [hspan]
    exact h.property
  obtain ⟨a, ha, b, hb, hab⟩ := Submodule.mem_sup.mp hh
  rcases ha with ⟨a, ha, rfl⟩
  rcases hb with ⟨b, hb, rfl⟩
  refine ⟨⟨a, ha⟩, ⟨b, hb⟩, ?_⟩
  apply Subtype.ext
  rw [Submodule.coe_add, thetaWindowMul_coe, thetaWindowMul_coe,
    thetaCoordinateFstOne_coe, thetaCoordinateSndOne_coe, one_mul]
  simpa only [Scheme.mulLinear_apply, one_mul] using hab.symm

/-! ## The same recurrence through the field theta pair -/

/-- Componentwise multiplication of field theta pairs. -/
noncomputable def thetaSectionPairMul (a b : Nat)
    (x : ↥(twistSubmodule k (fiberChart₀ pi) (fiberChart₁ pi)
      (thetaUnit pi ^ a) ⊤))
    (y : ↥(twistSubmodule k (fiberChart₀ pi) (fiberChart₁ pi)
      (thetaUnit pi ^ b) ⊤)) :
    ↥(twistSubmodule k (fiberChart₀ pi) (fiberChart₁ pi)
      (thetaUnit pi ^ (a + b)) ⊤) := by
  refine ⟨(x.1.1 * y.1.1, x.1.2 * y.1.2), ?_⟩
  rw [mem_twistSubmodule_iff]
  have hx := (mem_twistSubmodule_iff k (fiberChart₀ pi) (fiberChart₁ pi)
    (thetaUnit pi ^ a) x.1).mp x.2
  have hy := (mem_twistSubmodule_iff k (fiberChart₀ pi) (fiberChart₁ pi)
    (thetaUnit pi ^ b) y.1).mp y.2
  rw [map_mul, map_mul, pow_add, Units.val_mul, map_mul, hx, hy]
  ring

theorem thetaSectionPair_thetaWindowMul (p q : Nat)
    (a : ↥(divisorSections k (p • F) ⊤))
    (m : ↥(divisorSections k (q • F) ⊤)) :
    thetaSectionPair C pi (p + q)
        (thetaWindowMul (C := C) (pi := pi) p q a m) =
      thetaSectionPairMul (C := C) pi p q
        (thetaSectionPair C pi p a) (thetaSectionPair C pi q m) := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply Prod.ext
  · simpa [thetaSectionPairMul] using
      (thetaSectionPair_thetaWindowMul_fst C pi p q a m)
  · simpa [thetaSectionPairMul] using
      (thetaSectionPair_thetaWindowMul_snd C pi p q a m)

@[simp]
theorem thetaSectionPair_add (n : Nat)
    (a b : ↥(divisorSections k (n • F) ⊤)) :
    thetaSectionPair C pi n (a + b) =

   342	/-- **The `(M,s)`-coherence unit**: the product `u_s · u_M · u_{M+s}⁻¹` of the three
   343	class-comparison shift units.  Its divisor is exactly the transported-window
   344	discrepancy `T(M+s) − (N + S)` (`divOf_msCoherenceUnit`), and it realizes the `Φ`
   345	product defect (`divFamPhi_one_tmul_mul`). -/
   346	noncomputable def msCoherenceUnit : (relCurve C K).functionFieldˣ :=
   347	  thetaFieldShiftUnit C K π (windowS_choice π hπ g)
   348	    * thetaFieldShiftUnit C K π (windowM_choice π hπ g)
   349	    * (thetaFieldShiftUnit C K π (windowM_choice π hπ g + windowS_choice π hπ g))⁻¹

   351	/-- **The divisor of the coherence unit is the transported-window discrepancy**:
   352	`div (u_s·u_M·u_{M+s}⁻¹) = T(M+s) − (N + S)` — the theta-divisor terms cancel by the
   353	exponent additivity `thetaFieldDivisor_add`. -/
   354	theorem divOf_msCoherenceUnit :
   355	    windowTransportDivisor C K π (windowM_choice π hπ g + windowS_choice π hπ g)
   356	        - (windowN C K hπ g + windowS C K hπ g)
   357	      = Scheme.divOf (relCurve C K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
   358	          (msCoherenceUnit C K hπ g) := by
   359	  have hinv : Scheme.divOf (relCurve C K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
   360	        (thetaFieldShiftUnit C K π (windowM_choice π hπ g + windowS_choice π hπ g))⁻¹
   361	      = -Scheme.divOf (relCurve C K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
   362	          (thetaFieldShiftUnit C K π
   363	            (windowM_choice π hπ g + windowS_choice π hπ g)) := by
   364	    have h0 := Scheme.divOf_mul (relCurve C K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
   365	      (thetaFieldShiftUnit C K π (windowM_choice π hπ g + windowS_choice π hπ g))
   366	      (thetaFieldShiftUnit C K π (windowM_choice π hπ g + windowS_choice π hπ g))⁻¹
   367	    rw [mul_inv_cancel, Scheme.divOf_one] at h0
   368	    exact (neg_eq_of_add_eq_zero_right h0.symm).symm
   369	  rw [msCoherenceUnit, Scheme.divOf_mul, Scheme.divOf_mul, hinv,
   370	    ← divOf_thetaFieldShiftUnit C K π (windowS_choice π hπ g),
   371	    ← divOf_thetaFieldShiftUnit C K π (windowM_choice π hπ g),
   372	    ← divOf_thetaFieldShiftUnit C K π (windowM_choice π hπ g + windowS_choice π hπ g),
   373	    thetaFieldDivisor_add C K π (windowM_choice π hπ g) (windowS_choice π hπ g),
   374	    show windowN C K hπ g
   375	      = windowTransportDivisor C K π (windowM_choice π hπ g) from rfl,
   376	    show windowS C K hπ g
   377	      = windowTransportDivisor C K π (windowS_choice π hπ g) from rfl]

   380	/-- **The coherence-unit section translation**: multiplication by the coherence unit
   381	carries `H⁰(𝒪(T(M+s) − D))` exactly onto `H⁰(𝒪(N + S − D))` for every divisor `D` —

   413	/-- **The `Φ` product law** (the hcarve bridge, worksheet §1.5): the product of a
   414	multiplier value `Φ_s(1 ⊗ a)` with an `M`-window value `Φ_M(x)` is the coherence unit

1	/-

     6	
     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivSchemeMulSpanMap
     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# The finite Koszul boundary for a multiplication window
    11	
    12	Let `b : ι → U` be a finite multiplier basis.  If `L` is a preceding
    13	window and multiplication by `b i` sends `L` into the current window `T`,
    14	then a pair-indexed family `z : ι × ι → L` gives the usual row-minus-column
    15	relation
    16	
    17	`κ(z)_i = ∑ j, b_j z_(i,j) - b_j z_(j,i)`.
    18	
    19	The construction below is deliberately generic.  Its image is visibly killed
    20	by the finite component multiplication map; the converse inclusion is the
    21	actual high-window/Gotzmann syzygy theorem and is recorded at the end of this
    22	file as the remaining interface.
    23	-/
    24	
    25	set_option autoImplicit false
    26	
    27	universe u v
    28	
    29	open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace Opposite
    30	
    31	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    32	
    33	/-! ## A generic rows-minus-columns boundary -/
    34	
    35	variable {R L M N : Type u} [CommRing R]
    36	variable [AddCommGroup L] [Module R L]
    37	variable [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
    38	variable [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]
    39	variable {ι : Type v} [Fintype ι]
    40	
    41	/-- The alternating rows-minus-columns boundary attached to a family of
    42	`R`-linear maps `step i : L → M`.
    43	
    44	The two occurrences of `step` have the same multiplier index, while the
    45	outer index is the row of the resulting finite product.  This is the finite
    46	Koszul boundary used for multiplication syzygies.
    47	-/
    48	noncomputable def finiteKoszulBoundary (step : ι → L →ₗ[R] M) :
    49	    (ι × ι → L) →ₗ[R] (ι → M) := by
    50	  classical
    51	  refine
    52	    { toFun := fun z i =>
    53	        ∑ j, (step j (z (i, j)) - step j (z (j, i)))
    54	      map_add' := ?_
    55	      map_smul' := ?_ }
    56	  · intro x y
    57	    funext i
    58	    change
    59	      (∑ j, (step j ((x + y) (i, j)) - step j ((x + y) (j, i)))) =
    60	        (∑ j, (step j (x (i, j)) - step j (x (j, i)))) +
    61	          ∑ j, (step j (y (i, j)) - step j (y (j, i)))
    62	    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    63	    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    64	    intro j hj
    65	    simp only [Pi.add_apply, map_add]
    66	    abel
    67	  · intro r x
    68	    funext i
    69	    change
    70	      (∑ j, (step j ((r • x) (i, j)) - step j ((r • x) (j, i)))) =
    71	        r • (∑ j, (step j (x (i, j)) - step j (x (j, i))))
    72	    rw [Finset.smul_sum]
    73	    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    74	    intro j hj
    75	    simp only [Pi.smul_apply, map_smul, smul_sub]
    76	
    77	@[simp]
    78	theorem finiteKoszulBoundary_apply (step : ι → L →ₗ[R] M)
    79	    (z : ι × ι → L) (i : ι) :
    80	    finiteKoszulBoundary step z i =
    81	      ∑ j, (step j (z (i, j)) - step j (z (j, i))) := rfl
    82	
    83	/-! ## Composition with a finite component sum -/
    84	
    85	/-- The component sum kills the rows-minus-columns boundary whenever the
    86	component maps commute pairwise.  This is the substantive finite-stage
    87	syzygy direction (`range ≤ kernel`).
    88	-/
    89	theorem finiteComponentSum_comp_finiteKoszulBoundary_eq_zero
    90	    (row : ι → M →ₗ[R] N) (step : ι → L →ₗ[R] M)
    91	    (hcomm : ∀ (i j : ι) (z : L),
    92	      row i (step j z) = row j (step i z)) :
    93	    (finiteComponentSum row).comp (finiteKoszulBoundary step) = 0 := by
    94	  classical
    95	  apply LinearMap.ext
    96	  intro z
    97	  simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, finiteComponentSum, LinearMap.sum_apply,
    98	    LinearMap.proj_apply, finiteKoszulBoundary_apply]
    99	  simp_rw [map_sum, map_sub, Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
   100	  change
   101	    (∑ i, ∑ j, row i (step j (z (i, j)))) -
   102	        ∑ i, ∑ j, row i (step j (z (j, i))) = 0
   103	  have hswap :
   104	      (∑ i, ∑ j, row i (step j (z (j, i)))) =
   105	        ∑ i, ∑ j, row i (step j (z (i, j))) := by
   106	    calc
   107	      (∑ i, ∑ j, row i (step j (z (j, i)))) =
   108	          ∑ i, ∑ j, row j (step i (z (j, i))) := by
   109	        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   110	        intro i hi
   111	        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   112	        intro j hj
   113	        exact hcomm i j (z (j, i))
   114	      _ = ∑ j, ∑ i, row j (step i (z (j, i))) := by
   115	        rw [Finset.sum_comm]
   116	      _ = ∑ i, ∑ j, row i (step j (z (i, j))) := by
   117	        rfl
   118	  rw [hswap, sub_self]
   119	
   120	/-- Range form of the preceding composition identity. -/
   121	theorem range_finiteKoszulBoundary_le_ker_finiteComponentSum
   122	    (row : ι → M →ₗ[R] N) (step : ι → L →ₗ[R] M)
   123	    (hcomm : ∀ (i j : ι) (z : L),
   124	      row i (step j z) = row j (step i z)) :
   125	    LinearMap.range (finiteKoszulBoundary step) ≤
   126	      LinearMap.ker (finiteComponentSum row) := by
   127	  rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
   128	  apply LinearMap.mem_ker.mpr
   129	  have hz := LinearMap.congr_fun
   130	    (finiteComponentSum_comp_finiteKoszulBoundary_eq_zero row step hcomm) z
   131	  simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply] using hz
   132	
   133	/-! ## Scalar extension of the boundary -/
   134	
   135	section BaseChange
   136	
   137	variable {S : Type u} [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
   138	
   139	/-- Scalar extension of the finite Koszul boundary commutes with the canonical
   140	finite-product tensor equivalences.  This is the bridge that identifies the
   141	base-changed relative boundary with the boundary formed directly in a fibre.
   142	-/
   143	theorem piRightHom_comp_baseChange_finiteKoszulBoundary
   144	    (step : ι → L →ₗ[R] M) :
   145	    (TensorProduct.piRightHom R S S (fun _ : ι => M)).comp
   146	        (LinearMap.baseChange S (finiteKoszulBoundary step)) =
   147	      (finiteKoszulBoundary (fun i => LinearMap.baseChange S (step i))).comp
   148	        (TensorProduct.piRightHom R S S (fun _ : ι × ι => L)) := by
   149	  classical
   150	  apply LinearMap.ext
   151	  intro x
   152	  induction x using TensorProduct.induction_on with
   153	  | zero => simp
   154	  | add x y hx hy =>
   155	      simpa only [map_add, LinearMap.comp_apply] using congrArg₂ (· + ·) hx hy
   156	  | tmul a z =>
   157	      ext i
   158	      simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.baseChange_tmul,
   159	        TensorProduct.piRightHom_tmul, finiteKoszulBoundary_apply]
   160	      rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sum]
   161	      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   162	      intro j hj
   163	      rw [TensorProduct.tmul_sub]
   164	
   165	/-- After transporting the target finite product, the range of the
   166	base-changed boundary is exactly the range of the fibrewise boundary. -/
   167	theorem range_piRightHom_comp_baseChange_finiteKoszulBoundary
   168	    (step : ι → L →ₗ[R] M) :
   169	    LinearMap.range
   170	        ((TensorProduct.piRightHom R S S (fun _ : ι => M)).comp
   171	          (LinearMap.baseChange S (finiteKoszulBoundary step))) =
   172	      LinearMap.range
   173	        (finiteKoszulBoundary (fun i => LinearMap.baseChange S (step i))) := by
   174	  classical
   175	  rw [piRightHom_comp_baseChange_finiteKoszulBoundary]
   176	  apply le_antisymm
   177	  · rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
   178	    exact LinearMap.mem_range_self _ _
   179	  · rintro _ ⟨z, rfl⟩
   180	    let e := TensorProduct.piRight R S S (fun _ : ι × ι => L)
   181	    refine ⟨e.symm z, ?_⟩
   182	    simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply]
   183	    have he : TensorProduct.piRightHom R S S (fun _ : ι × ι => L) (e.symm z) = z := by
   184	      change e (e.symm z) = z
   185	      exact e.apply_symm_apply z
   186	    rw [he]
   187	
   188	end BaseChange
   189	
   190	/-! ## A finite-dimensional equality criterion -/
   191	
   192	section Finrank
   193	
   194	variable {k₀ A V W : Type u} [Field k₀]
   195	variable [AddCommGroup A] [Module k₀ A]
   196	variable [AddCommGroup V] [Module k₀ V] [FiniteDimensional k₀ V]
   197	variable [AddCommGroup W] [Module k₀ W]
   198	
   199	/-- Over a field, the easy inclusion `range κ ≤ ker μ` is an equality as soon
   200	as the Koszul range has at least the dimension of the multiplication kernel.
   201	Thus the reverse syzygy theorem is reduced to its genuine Gotzmann rank input.
   202	-/
   203	theorem ker_finiteComponentSum_eq_range_finiteKoszulBoundary_of_finrank_le
   204	    (row : ι → V →ₗ[k₀] W) (step : ι → A →ₗ[k₀] V)
   205	    (hcomm : ∀ (i j : ι) (z : A),
   206	      row i (step j z) = row j (step i z))
   207	    (hfin : Module.finrank k₀ (LinearMap.ker (finiteComponentSum row)) ≤
   208	      Module.finrank k₀ (LinearMap.range (finiteKoszulBoundary step))) :
   209	    LinearMap.ker (finiteComponentSum row) =
   210	      LinearMap.range (finiteKoszulBoundary step) := by
   211	  symm
   212	  exact Submodule.eq_of_le_of_finrank_le
   213	    (range_finiteKoszulBoundary_le_ker_finiteComponentSum row step hcomm) hfin
   214	
   215	end Finrank
   216	
   217	/-! ## The multiplication-window specialization -/
   218	
   219	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.functionFieldOverModule
   220	
   221	variable {K : Type u} [Field K]
   222	variable {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] [IsIntegral X]
   223	variable {ι : Type v} [Fintype ι]
   224	
   225	/-- Multiplication by the `i`-th multiplier basis vector, corestricted to the
   226	current window `T`.  The hypothesis records the only geometric input needed
   227	to form this map.
   228	-/
   229	noncomputable def Scheme.finiteMulStepTo
   230	    (U L T : Submodule K X.functionField) (b : Module.Basis ι K U)
   231	    (hmul : ∀ (i : ι) (z : L),
   232	      (b i : X.functionField) * (z : X.functionField) ∈ T)
   233	    (i : ι) : L →ₗ[K] T :=
   234	  ((Scheme.mulLinear K (b i : X.functionField)).comp L.subtype).codRestrict T
   235	    (fun z => by
   236	      simpa only [LinearMap.comp_apply, Submodule.subtype_apply,
   237	        Scheme.mulLinear_apply] using hmul i z)
   238	
   239	omit [Fintype ι] in
   240	@[simp]
   241	theorem Scheme.finiteMulStepTo_apply
   242	    (U L T : Submodule K X.functionField) (b : Module.Basis ι K U)
   243	    (hmul : ∀ (i : ι) (z : L),
   244	      (b i : X.functionField) * (z : X.functionField) ∈ T)
   245	    (i : ι) (z : L) :
   246	    ((Scheme.finiteMulStepTo U L T b hmul i z : T) : X.functionField) =
   247	      (b i : X.functionField) * (z : X.functionField) := by
   248	  rfl
   249	
   250	/-- The finite Koszul boundary for the multiplication window `U · L ⊆ T`. -/
   251	noncomputable def Scheme.finiteMulKoszulBoundary
   252	    (U L T : Submodule K X.functionField) (b : Module.Basis ι K U)
   253	    (hmul : ∀ (i : ι) (z : L),
   254	      (b i : X.functionField) * (z : X.functionField) ∈ T) :
   255	    (ι × ι → L) →ₗ[K] (ι → T) :=
   256	  finiteKoszulBoundary (fun i => Scheme.finiteMulStepTo U L T b hmul i)
   257	
   258	/-- The finite product map kills the multiplication Koszul boundary. -/
   259	theorem Scheme.finiteMulMap_comp_finiteMulKoszulBoundary_eq_zero
   260	    (U L T : Submodule K X.functionField) (b : Module.Basis ι K U)
   261	    (hmul : ∀ (i : ι) (z : L),
   262	      (b i : X.functionField) * (z : X.functionField) ∈ T) :
   263	    (Scheme.finiteMulMap U T b).comp
   264	        (Scheme.finiteMulKoszulBoundary U L T b hmul) = 0 := by
   265	  apply finiteComponentSum_comp_finiteKoszulBoundary_eq_zero
   266	  intro i j z
   267	  change
   268	    (b i : X.functionField) *
   269	          ((b j : X.functionField) * (z : X.functionField)) =
   270	      (b j : X.functionField) *
   271	          ((b i : X.functionField) * (z : X.functionField))
   272	  ring
   273	
   274	/-- Range form of `finiteMulMap_comp_finiteMulKoszulBoundary_eq_zero`. -/
   275	theorem Scheme.range_finiteMulKoszulBoundary_le_ker_finiteMulMap
   276	    (U L T : Submodule K X.functionField) (b : Module.Basis ι K U)
   277	    (hmul : ∀ (i : ι) (z : L),
   278	      (b i : X.functionField) * (z : X.functionField) ∈ T) :
   279	    LinearMap.range (Scheme.finiteMulKoszulBoundary U L T b hmul) ≤
   280	      LinearMap.ker (Scheme.finiteMulMap U T b) := by
   281	  exact range_finiteKoszulBoundary_le_ker_finiteComponentSum
   282	    (row := fun i =>
   283	      (Scheme.mulLinear K (b i : X.functionField)).comp T.subtype)
   284	    (step := fun i => Scheme.finiteMulStepTo U L T b hmul i) (by
   285	      intro i j z
   286	      change
   287	        (b i : X.functionField) *
   288	              ((b j : X.functionField) * (z : X.functionField)) =
   289	          (b j : X.functionField) *
   290	              ((b i : X.functionField) * (z : X.functionField))
   291	      ring)
   292	
   293	/-- A finite-dimensional rank lower bound upgrades the multiplication
   294	Koszul inclusion to the exact kernel presentation.  This is the direct
   295	consumer interface for a fieldwise Gotzmann dimension calculation. -/
   296	theorem Scheme.ker_finiteMulMap_eq_range_finiteMulKoszulBoundary_of_finrank_le
   297	    (U L T : Submodule K X.functionField) (b : Module.Basis ι K U)

    10	/-!
    11	# Persistence at every high divisor-scheme window
    12	
    13	The two Grassmannian windows recover an effective degree-`g` divisor `D` on every
    14	field fibre.  The same multiplication argument is not confined to those first two
    15	windows: after replacing `N` by `N + n * S`, the degree budgets only improve.  Thus
    16	the full `S`-window carries `H^0(O(N + n*S - D))` onto the next stage for every `n`.
    17	
    18	This is the field-level persistence input for an eventual relative saturation or
    19	direct-limit construction.  It does not itself construct the relative high-window
    20	modules over the carve-chart ring.
    21	-/
    22	
    23	set_option autoImplicit false
    24	
    25	universe u
    26	
    27	open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace

    29	namespace AlgebraicGeometry

    33	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra

    36	section Pack
    37	
    38	variable {K : Type u} [Field K] {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral Y]
    39	  [Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    40	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    41	  [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    42	  [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    43	  [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (Y.moduleKSheaf K) 0)]
    44	  [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (Y.moduleKSheaf K) 1)]
    45	
    46	/-- Multiplication persistence is uniform in the high-window index.  The hypotheses
    47	are exactly the abstract P-fib window pack at `N` and `S`; at `N + n • S` all degree
    48	and normalization inequalities follow from the original ones. -/
    49	theorem mulSpan_divisorSections_highWindow_of_pack
    50	    (g : ℕ) (hO : Sheaf.h0 (Y.moduleKSheaf K) = 1)
    51	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (Y.moduleKSheaf K) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
    52	    (N S : Y.CurveDivisor) (β : ℤ)
    53	    (hvan : ∀ W : Y.CurveDivisor, β ≤ CurveDivisor.deg K W →
    54	      Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (Y.divisorSheaf K W) 1))
    55	    (hNdeg : 2 * (g : ℤ) ≤ CurveDivisor.deg K N)
    56	    (hSdeg : 2 * (g : ℤ) ≤ CurveDivisor.deg K S)
    57	    (hβS : β + 2 * (g : ℤ) ≤ CurveDivisor.deg K S)
    58	    (hβN : β + 2 * (g : ℤ) + CurveDivisor.deg K S ≤ CurveDivisor.deg K N)
    59	    (D : Y.CurveDivisor) (hD0 : 0 ≤ D)
    60	    (hDdeg : CurveDivisor.deg K D = (g : ℤ)) (n : ℕ) :
    61	    Scheme.mulSpan K (divisorSections K S ⊤)
    62	        (divisorSections K (N + n • S - D) ⊤) =
    63	      divisorSections K (N + (n + 1) • S - D) ⊤ := by
    64	  classical
    65	  let Nn : Y.CurveDivisor := N + n • S
    66	  have hSdeg0 : 0 ≤ CurveDivisor.deg K S := by omega
    67	  have hNndeg : CurveDivisor.deg K Nn =
    68	      CurveDivisor.deg K N + (n : ℤ) * CurveDivisor.deg K S := by
    69	    dsimp [Nn]
    70	    rw [CurveDivisor.deg_add, Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_nsmul']
    71	  have hβNn : β + 2 * (g : ℤ) + CurveDivisor.deg K S ≤
    72	      CurveDivisor.deg K Nn := by
    73	    rw [hNndeg]
    74	    have hn : 0 ≤ (n : ℤ) * CurveDivisor.deg K S :=
    75	      mul_nonneg (Int.natCast_nonneg n) hSdeg0
    76	    omega
    77	  have hNnDeg : 2 * (g : ℤ) ≤ CurveDivisor.deg K Nn := by
    78	    rw [hNndeg]
    79	    have hn : 0 ≤ (n : ℤ) * CurveDivisor.deg K S :=
    80	      mul_nonneg (Int.natCast_nonneg n) hSdeg0
    81	    omega
    82	  have hNnNorm : ∀ D' : Y.CurveDivisor,
    83	      CurveDivisor.deg K D' ≤ 2 * (g : ℤ) →
    84	        Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (Y.divisorSheaf K (Nn - D')) 1) := by
    85	    intro D' hD'
    86	    apply hvan
    87	    rw [Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_sub' K, hNndeg]
    88	    have hn : 0 ≤ (n : ℤ) * CurveDivisor.deg K S :=
    89	      mul_nonneg (Int.natCast_nonneg n) hSdeg0
    90	    omega
    91	  let T : Submodule K Y.functionField := divisorSections K (Nn - D) ⊤
    92	  have hTne : ∃ f ∈ T, f ≠ 0 :=
    93	    exists_mem_ne_zero_of_window_normalization g hχ Nn hNnNorm hNnDeg D hDdeg rfl
    94	  have hTD : T ≤ divisorSections K Nn ⊤ := by
    95	    refine Scheme.divisorSections_mono K ?_ ⊤
    96	    refine Scheme.CurveDivisor.le_iff_coeffAt.mpr fun x hx => ?_
    97	    rw [Scheme.CurveDivisor.coeffAt_sub]
    98	    have hDx := Scheme.CurveDivisor.le_iff_coeffAt.mp hD0 x hx
    99	    rw [Scheme.CurveDivisor.coeffAt_zero] at hDx
   100	    omega
   101	  have hbase : Scheme.baseDivisor K T Nn hTne = D :=
   102	    baseDivisor_window_normalization g hO hχ Nn hNnNorm hNnDeg D hD0 hDdeg rfl hTne
   103	  have hbpf : ∀ (x : Y) (hx : x ≠ genericPoint Y),
   104	      ∃ (f : Y.functionField) (_ : f ∈ T) (hf : f ≠ 0),
   105	        coeffAt hx ((Nn - D)
   106	          + Scheme.divOf (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) (Units.mk0 f hf)) = 0 := by
   107	    intro x hx
   108	    have h := Scheme.exists_achiever_baseDivisor_sub K hTD hTne hx
   109	    rwa [hbase] at h
   110	  have hspan := mulSpan_eq_divisorSections_of_basepointFree_pack
   111	    g hO hχ Nn S β hvan hSdeg hβS hβNn D hD0 hDdeg.le T
   112	      (by exact le_rfl) 0 (Nat.zero_le g) (by
   113	        simpa only [Nat.add_zero, T] using
   114	          (finrank_divisorSections_top K (Nn - D))) hbpf
   115	  simpa only [T, Nn, add_nsmul, one_nsmul, add_assoc] using hspan
   116	
   117	end Pack

   179	/-- The canonical high-window fibre cut out by the universal divisor recovered from

   188	/-- Stage zero is the first universal fibre window. -/

   190	    divUniversalFibreHighWindow C hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j K hO hchi hker 0 =
   191	      divUniversalFibreKM C hpi g r1 r2 b1 i j K := by
   192	  rw [divUniversalFibreHighWindow, zero_nsmul, add_zero]
   193	  exact (divUniversalFibreDivisor_spec

   197	/-- Stage one is the second universal fibre window. -/

   199	    divUniversalFibreHighWindow C hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j K hO hchi hker 1 =
   200	      divUniversalFibreK' C hpi g r1 r2 b2 i j K := by
   201	  rw [divUniversalFibreHighWindow, one_nsmul]
   202	  exact (divUniversalFibreDivisor_spec
   203	    C hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j K hO hchi hker).2.2.2.symm
   204	
   205	set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
   206	-- Instantiating the abstract pack unfolds both transported window dictionaries.
   207	/-- Every canonical high fibre window is generated from its predecessor by the full
   208	multiplier window. -/
   209	theorem divUniversalFibreHighWindow_mulSpan_eq_of_windowBound_pos
   210	    (hb : 0 < windowBound pi hpi) (n : ℕ) :
   211	    Scheme.mulSpan K (Scheme.divisorSections K (windowS C K hpi g) ⊤)
   212	        (divUniversalFibreHighWindow
   213	          C hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j K hO hchi hker n) =
   214	      divUniversalFibreHighWindow
   215	        C hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j K hO hchi hker (n + 1) := by
   216	  rw [divUniversalFibreHighWindow, divUniversalFibreHighWindow]
   217	  have hspec := divUniversalFibreDivisor_spec
   218	    C hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j K hO hchi hker
   219	  refine mulSpan_divisorSections_highWindow_of_pack

    11	/-!
    12	# Unit generation by a finite theta-window basis
    13	
    14	The two canonical relative theta sections `(t₀ᵃ, 1)` and `(1, t₁ᵃ)` have a unit
    15	component on the second and first pinned charts respectively.  Pulling either section
    16	back through `relThetaWindowEquiv` and expanding it in a base-changed finite basis shows
    17	that the corresponding chart readings of that basis generate `1`.
    18	-/
    19	
    20	set_option autoImplicit false
    21	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
    22	
    23	universe u v
    24	
    25	open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace Opposite
    26	open scoped TensorProduct
    27	
    28	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    29	
    30	open Scheme
    31	
    32	attribute [local instance] Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
    33	attribute [local instance 10000] relCurve.instOver

    35	section Basis
    36	
    37	variable {k R M B : Type u} {ι : Type v} [Field k] [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
    38	variable [AddCommGroup M] [Module k M] [CommRing B] [Algebra R B]
    39	variable [Fintype ι]
    40	
    41	/-- If an `R`-linear map out of `R ⊗[k] M` takes some element to `1`, then the
    42	images of the scalar extensions of a finite `k`-basis of `M` generate `1` in `B`. -/
    43	theorem exists_basis_baseChange_mul_eq_one (basis : Module.Basis ι k M)
    44	    (f : R ⊗[k] M →ₗ[R] B) (x : R ⊗[k] M) (hx : f x = 1) :
    45	    ∃ c : ι → B, ∑ t, c t * f (1 ⊗ₜ basis t) = 1 := by
    46	  classical
    47	  let basisR := basis.baseChange R
    48	  refine ⟨fun t => (basisR.repr x t) • 1, ?_⟩
    49	  calc
    50	    ∑ t, ((basisR.repr x t) • 1) * f (1 ⊗ₜ basis t) =
    51	        ∑ t, (basisR.repr x t) • f (basisR t) := by
    52	      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    53	      intro t _
    54	      simp only [basisR, Module.Basis.baseChange_apply, Algebra.smul_def, mul_one]
    55	    _ = f (∑ t, (basisR.repr x t) • basisR t) := by
    56	      rw [map_sum]
    57	      simp only [map_smul]
    58	    _ = f x := by rw [basisR.sum_repr]
    59	    _ = 1 := hx
    60	
    61	end Basis

    63	section ThetaWindow
    64	
    65	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    66	variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
    67	variable (π : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite π]
    68	
    69	noncomputable local instance instOverCleftWindowUnit : C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩
    70	
    71	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsIntegral C.left]
    72	  [LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    73	  [IsDominant π]
    74	variable (a : ℕ)
    75	
    76	/-- The window equivalence followed by the pinned-chart component reading. -/
    77	noncomputable def relThetaWindowChartRead
    78	    (hH1 : Subsingleton (relTwistPair C k π (relThetaCocycle C k π a)).H1)
    79	    (b : Bool) :
    80	    R ⊗[k] ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k (a • fiberWeilDivisor π) ⊤) →ₗ[R]
    81	      Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b) :=
    82	  (relThetaResSide a b le_rfl).comp (relThetaWindowEquiv C R π a hH1).toLinearMap
    83	
    84	/-- The readings of any finite basis of a theta window generate `1` on either pinned
    85	chart after scalar extension. -/
    86	theorem exists_basis_relThetaWindowChartRead_mul_eq_one {ι : Type v} [Fintype ι]
    87	    (basis : Module.Basis ι k
    88	      ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k (a • fiberWeilDivisor π) ⊤))
    89	    (hH1 : Subsingleton (relTwistPair C k π (relThetaCocycle C k π a)).H1)
    90	    (b : Bool) :
    91	    ∃ c : ι → Γ(relCurve C R, relPinnedChart C R π b),
    92	      ∑ t, c t * relThetaWindowChartRead C R π a hH1 b (1 ⊗ₜ basis t) = 1 := by
    93	  cases b
    94	  · apply exists_basis_baseChange_mul_eq_one basis
    95	      (relThetaWindowChartRead C R π a hH1 false)
    96	      ((relThetaWindowEquiv C R π a hH1).symm (relThetaSectionSnd C R π a))
    97	    change relThetaResFst a (le_inf le_top le_rfl)
    98	      ((relThetaWindowEquiv C R π a hH1)
    99	        ((relThetaWindowEquiv C R π a hH1).symm (relThetaSectionSnd C R π a))) = 1
   100	    rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
   101	    exact relThetaResFst_relThetaSectionSnd C R π a
   102	  · apply exists_basis_baseChange_mul_eq_one basis
   103	      (relThetaWindowChartRead C R π a hH1 true)
   104	      ((relThetaWindowEquiv C R π a hH1).symm (relThetaSectionFst C R π a))
   105	    change relThetaResSnd a (le_inf le_top le_rfl)
   106	      ((relThetaWindowEquiv C R π a hH1)
   107	        ((relThetaWindowEquiv C R π a hH1).symm (relThetaSectionFst C R π a))) = 1
   108	    rw [LinearEquiv.apply_symm_apply]
   109	    exact relThetaResSnd_relThetaSectionFst C R π a
   110	
   111	end ThetaWindow

    10	/-!
    11	# FLV-1 — the twist lattices of `𝒪(D + n·F)` on the π-two-cover
    12	
    13	This is the Wave-4 **fibrewise-large-twist-vanishing** lattice brick (`informal/w4-flv-worksheet.md`
    14	§2.1, brick FLV-1). It records, as *submodule identities in the function field* `K(Y)` (the D1
    15	discipline), how the section lattices of the twisted divisor sheaf `𝒪(D + n·F)` behave on the
    16	pinned affine two-cover `V₀ = π⁻¹ D₊(X₀)`, `V₁ = π⁻¹ D₊(X₁)`, where `F = fiberWeilDivisor π` is the
    17	fiber divisor of FLV-0 and `u = fiberCoordUnit π` its equation:
    18	
    19	* over `V₁` and over the overlap `V₀ ⊓ V₁` the lattice is **unchanged** (`= 𝒪(D)`), since `F`
    20	  is supported off `V₁` (`divisorSections_add_nsmul_fiberWeilDivisor_chart₁`,
    21	  `..._overlap`);
    22	* over `V₀` the lattice is `u⁻ⁿ · 𝒪(D)(V₀)` (the `mulEquivDivisorSheaf` mechanism, section level:
    23	  `divisorSections_add_nsmul_fiberWeilDivisor_chart₀`), a submodule that **grows** with `n`.
    24	
    25	From these the two-cover Čech `H¹` denominators
    26	`Aₙ := 𝒪(D)(V₁)|N ⊔ (u⁻ⁿ · 𝒪(D)(V₀))|N` inside `N := 𝒪(D)(V₀ ⊓ V₁)` form an **increasing chain**
    27	(`fiberLattice_mono`) that **exhausts** `N` (`iSup_fiberLattice`) — the pole-clearing at the finite
    28	fiber over `[1 : 0]` — which is the endgame the exhaustion brick (FLV-3) consumes.
    29	-/

    45	variable {K : Type u} [Field K] {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral Y]

    52	/-! ## Coefficient bookkeeping for the twist -/
    53	
    54	/-- The coefficient of an `ℕ`-multiple of a divisor scales linearly. -/
    55	private lemma coeffAt_nsmul (n : ℕ) (D : Y.CurveDivisor) {x : Y} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint Y) :
    56	    coeffAt hx (n • D) = (n : ℤ) * coeffAt hx D := by
    57	  induction n with
    58	  | zero => rw [zero_smul, CurveDivisor.coeffAt_zero, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul]
    59	  | succ m ih => rw [succ_nsmul, CurveDivisor.coeffAt_add, ih, Nat.cast_succ]; ring
    60	
    61	/-- The divisor bound depends only on the coefficient at the point. -/
    62	private lemma divisorBound_congr {A B : Y.CurveDivisor} {x : Y} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint Y)
    63	    (h : coeffAt hx A = coeffAt hx B) : Scheme.divisorBound A hx = Scheme.divisorBound B hx :=
    64	  congrArg (fun m : Multiplicative ℤ => (m : WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)))
    65	    (congrArg Multiplicative.ofAdd h)
    66	
    67	/-- On `V₁` the twisted divisor `D + n·F` has the same coefficients as `D`: `F` vanishes there. -/
    68	private lemma coeffAt_add_nsmul_of_mem_chart₁ (D : Y.CurveDivisor) (n : ℕ) {x : Y}
    69	    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint Y) (hxV₁ : x ∈ fiberChart₁ π) :
    70	    coeffAt hx (D + n • fiberWeilDivisor π) = coeffAt hx D := by
    71	  rw [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_add, coeffAt_nsmul,
    72	    fiberWeilDivisor_coeffAt_of_mem_chart₁ π hx hxV₁, mul_zero, add_zero]
    73	
    74	/-! ## The constant lattices: over `V₁` and over the overlap -/
    75	
    76	/-- **The lattice over `V₁` is unchanged by the twist.** Since `F` is supported off `V₁`, the
    77	sections of `𝒪(D + n·F)` over `V₁ = π⁻¹ D₊(X₁)` coincide with those of `𝒪(D)`. -/
    78	theorem divisorSections_add_nsmul_fiberWeilDivisor_chart₁ (D : Y.CurveDivisor) (n : ℕ) :
    79	    divisorSections K (D + n • fiberWeilDivisor π) (fiberChart₁ π)
    80	      = divisorSections K D (fiberChart₁ π) := by
    81	  have hne : (fiberChart₁ π : Set Y).Nonempty :=
    82	    ⟨genericPoint Y, (genericPoint_mem_preimage_inf π).2⟩
    83	  rw [divisorSections_of_nonempty K hne, divisorSections_of_nonempty K hne]
    84	  have hbound : ∀ (x : Y) (hx : x ≠ genericPoint Y), x ∈ fiberChart₁ π →
    85	      Scheme.divisorBound (D + n • fiberWeilDivisor π) hx = Scheme.divisorBound D hx :=
    86	    fun x hx hxV₁ => divisorBound_congr hx (coeffAt_add_nsmul_of_mem_chart₁ π D n hx hxV₁)
    87	  refine Submodule.ext (fun g => ?_)
    88	  rw [mem_boundedSections, mem_boundedSections]
    89	  constructor
    90	  · intro h x hx hxU; rw [← hbound x hx hxU]; exact h x hx hxU
    91	  · intro h x hx hxU; rw [hbound x hx hxU]; exact h x hx hxU
    92	
    93	/-- **The lattice over the overlap is unchanged by the twist.** The overlap `V₀ ⊓ V₁` lies in `V₁`,
    94	where `F` vanishes, so `𝒪(D + n·F)(V₀ ⊓ V₁) = 𝒪(D)(V₀ ⊓ V₁) =: N`, the fixed ambient of the Čech
    95	`H¹` quotient. -/
    96	theorem divisorSections_add_nsmul_fiberWeilDivisor_overlap (D : Y.CurveDivisor) (n : ℕ) :
    97	    divisorSections K (D + n • fiberWeilDivisor π) (fiberChart₀ π ⊓ fiberChart₁ π)
    98	      = divisorSections K D (fiberChart₀ π ⊓ fiberChart₁ π) := by
    99	  have hne : ((fiberChart₀ π ⊓ fiberChart₁ π : Y.Opens) : Set Y).Nonempty :=
   100	    ⟨genericPoint Y, genericPoint_mem_preimage_inf π⟩
   101	  rw [divisorSections_of_nonempty K hne, divisorSections_of_nonempty K hne]
   102	  have hbound : ∀ (x : Y) (hx : x ≠ genericPoint Y), x ∈ fiberChart₀ π ⊓ fiberChart₁ π →
   103	      Scheme.divisorBound (D + n • fiberWeilDivisor π) hx = Scheme.divisorBound D hx :=
   104	    fun x hx hxU => divisorBound_congr hx (coeffAt_add_nsmul_of_mem_chart₁ π D n hx hxU.2)
   105	  refine Submodule.ext (fun g => ?_)
   106	  rw [mem_boundedSections, mem_boundedSections]
   107	  constructor
   108	  · intro h x hx hxU; rw [← hbound x hx hxU]; exact h x hx hxU
   109	  · intro h x hx hxU; rw [hbound x hx hxU]; exact h x hx hxU

   111	/-! ## The growing lattice over `V₀` -/
   112	
   113	/-- The classical order of `v⁻¹` is the negative of that of `v`, coefficient-wise. -/
   114	private lemma coeffAt_divOf_inv (v : Y.functionFieldˣ) {x : Y} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint Y) :
   115	    coeffAt hx (Scheme.divOf (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v⁻¹) =
   116	      - coeffAt hx (Scheme.divOf (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v) := by
   117	  have h : Scheme.divOf (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v⁻¹
   118	      + Scheme.divOf (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v = 0 := by
   119	    rw [← Scheme.divOf_mul (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)), inv_mul_cancel,
   120	      Scheme.divOf_one (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
   121	  have hc := congrArg (coeffAt hx) h
   122	  rw [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_add, CurveDivisor.coeffAt_zero] at hc
   123	  linarith
   124	
   125	/-- The classical order of `vⁿ` scales linearly. -/
   126	private lemma coeffAt_divOf_pow (v : Y.functionFieldˣ) (n : ℕ) {x : Y} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint Y) :
   127	    coeffAt hx (Scheme.divOf (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) (v ^ n)) =
   128	      (n : ℤ) * coeffAt hx (Scheme.divOf (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) v) := by
   129	  induction n with
   130	  | zero => rw [pow_zero, Scheme.divOf_one, CurveDivisor.coeffAt_zero, Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul]
   131	  | succ m ih =>
   132	    rw [pow_succ, Scheme.divOf_mul, CurveDivisor.coeffAt_add, ih, Nat.cast_succ]; ring
   133	
   134	/-- **The lattice over `V₀` grows as `u⁻ⁿ · 𝒪(D)(V₀)`.** Multiplication by `u⁻ⁿ = fiberCoordUnit π
   135	⁻ⁿ` carries `𝒪(D)(V₀)` isomorphically onto `𝒪(D + n·F)(V₀)`: the `mulEquivDivisorSheaf` mechanism
   136	at the section level, the source of the growing denominator of the Čech `H¹` quotient. -/
   137	theorem divisorSections_add_nsmul_fiberWeilDivisor_chart₀ (D : Y.CurveDivisor) (n : ℕ) :
   138	    divisorSections K (D + n • fiberWeilDivisor π) (fiberChart₀ π)
   139	      = Submodule.map (mulByUnit K ((fiberCoordUnit π)⁻¹ ^ n)).toLinearMap
   140	          (divisorSections K D (fiberChart₀ π)) := by
   141	  have hne : (fiberChart₀ π : Set Y).Nonempty :=
   142	    ⟨genericPoint Y, (genericPoint_mem_preimage_inf π).1⟩
   143	  set w : Y.functionFieldˣ := (fiberCoordUnit π)⁻¹ ^ n with hw
   144	  -- coefficientwise, `D + n·F` agrees with `D - div w` on `V₀`.
   145	  have hcoeff : ∀ (x : Y) (hx : x ≠ genericPoint Y), x ∈ fiberChart₀ π →
   146	      coeffAt hx (D + n • fiberWeilDivisor π)
   147	        = coeffAt hx (D - Scheme.divOf (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) w) := by
   148	    intro x hx hxV₀
   149	    rw [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_add, coeffAt_nsmul, CurveDivisor.coeffAt_sub, hw,
   150	      coeffAt_divOf_pow, coeffAt_divOf_inv,
   151	      fiberWeilDivisor_coeffAt_of_mem_chart₀ π hx hxV₀]
   152	    ring
   153	  -- hence the two bounded lattices coincide.
   154	  have hbdd : Scheme.boundedSections K (D + n • fiberWeilDivisor π) (fiberChart₀ π)
   155	      = Scheme.boundedSections K (D - Scheme.divOf (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) w)
   156	        (fiberChart₀ π) := by
   157	    refine Submodule.ext (fun g => ?_)
   158	    rw [Scheme.mem_boundedSections, Scheme.mem_boundedSections]
   159	    refine forall_congr' (fun x => forall_congr' (fun hx => imp_congr_right (fun hxV₀ => ?_)))
   160	    rw [divisorBound_congr hx (hcoeff x hx hxV₀)]
   161	  rw [divisorSections_of_nonempty K hne, hbdd]
   162	  -- multiplication by `w` identifies `𝒪(D - div w)(V₀)` with `w · 𝒪(D)(V₀)`.
   163	  refine Submodule.ext (fun y => ?_)
   164	  rw [Submodule.mem_map]
   165	  constructor
   166	  · intro hy
   167	    refine ⟨(↑w⁻¹ : Y.functionField) * y, ?_, ?_⟩
   168	    · rw [divisorSections_of_nonempty K hne, ← Scheme.mem_boundedSections_mul_iff K w D,
   169	        ← mul_assoc, Units.mul_inv, one_mul]
   170	      exact hy
   171	    · simp only [Scheme.mulByUnit_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe, ← mul_assoc, Units.mul_inv, one_mul]
   172	  · rintro ⟨h, hh, rfl⟩
   173	    rw [divisorSections_of_nonempty K hne] at hh
   174	    simp only [Scheme.mulByUnit_apply, LinearEquiv.coe_coe]
   175	    exact (Scheme.mem_boundedSections_mul_iff K w D (h : Y.functionField)).mpr hh
   176	
   177	/-! ## The Čech-`H¹` denominator lattice `Aₙ` and its ladder -/
   178	
   179	/-- **The two-cover Čech `H¹` denominator lattice** `Aₙ` of `𝒪(D + n·F)`: the join, inside the
   180	function field, of the section lattices over `V₀` and `V₁`. As submodules of `N = 𝒪(D)(V₀ ⊓ V₁)`
   181	(`fiberLattice_le_overlap`) these are exactly the images of the restriction maps of the two-cover
   182	Čech complex, so `N ⧸ Aₙ` is the two-cover `H¹` (the identification the exhaustion endgame,
   183	FLV-3, consumes). -/
   184	noncomputable def fiberLattice (D : Y.CurveDivisor) (n : ℕ) : Submodule K Y.functionField :=
   185	  divisorSections K (D + n • fiberWeilDivisor π) (fiberChart₀ π)
   186	    ⊔ divisorSections K (D + n • fiberWeilDivisor π) (fiberChart₁ π)
   187	
   188	/-- **`Aₙ` lies in the ambient `N = 𝒪(D)(V₀ ⊓ V₁)`.** Both section lattices restrict into the
   189	overlap sections, which the twist leaves fixed (`..._overlap`). -/
   190	theorem fiberLattice_le_overlap (D : Y.CurveDivisor) (n : ℕ) :

     8	/-!
     9	# DD-F brick 1 — the base divisor of a subspace of `H⁰(𝒪(A))`
    10	
    11	The normalization vocabulary of the P-fib route (`informal/dat-d-worksheet.md` §3.3 F1,
    12	`informal/dd-f-probe-verdict.md` inventory brick 1): for a subspace `T ⊆ H⁰(𝒪(A))` of the
    13	global sections of a divisor sheaf with a nonzero element, the **base divisor**
    14	`bd(T) = ∑ₓ min_{0 ≠ f ∈ T} (A + div f)ₓ · x` records, at each closed point, the deepest
    15	common zero of the shifted divisors `A + div f ≥ 0`. Provided:
    16	
    17	* `Scheme.baseDivisorAt` — the pointwise minimum, as a `ℕ`-valued `sInf` (well-defined
    18	  since `T ⊆ H⁰(𝒪(A))` makes every `A + div f` effective);
    19	* `Scheme.baseDivisor` — the assembled Weil divisor, finitely supported because it is
    20	  bounded by any one `A + div f₀`;
    21	* `baseDivisor_nonneg`, `coeffAt_baseDivisor` — effectivity and the pointwise value;
    22	* `baseDivisorAt_le_coeffAt` — the lower-bound property (`bd(T) ≤ A + div f` for every
    23	  nonzero `f ∈ T`);
    24	* `exists_coeffAt_eq_baseDivisorAt` — the **achiever**: at every closed point some
    25	  nonzero `f ∈ T` attains the minimum (`Nat.sInf_mem`);
    26	* `le_divisorSections_sub_baseDivisor` — `T ⊆ H⁰(𝒪(A − bd T))`;
    27	* `exists_achiever_baseDivisor_sub` — **no residual base point**: relative to
    28	  `A − bd T`, the subspace `T` has an exact-order element at every closed point. This is
    29	  the `hbpf` input of the bpf-span lemma (F3-core).
    30	
    31	Everything is `ord`/`coeffAt` calculus on `mem_divisorSections_top_iff`; no cohomology.
    32	-/

    52	/-! ## The pointwise minimum -/
    53	
    54	/-- The candidate multiplicities of the base divisor of `T` relative to `A` at the closed
    55	point `p`: the values `(A + div f)ₚ` over nonzero `f ∈ T`, truncated to `ℕ` (faithful once
    56	`T ⊆ H⁰(𝒪(A))`, which makes every `A + div f` effective). -/
    57	def Scheme.baseDivisorSet (T : Submodule K X.functionField) (A : X.CurveDivisor)
    58	    (p : {x : X // x ≠ genericPoint X}) : Set ℕ :=
    59	  {n : ℕ | ∃ (f : X.functionField) (_ : f ∈ T) (hf : f ≠ 0),
    60	    (coeffAt p.2
    61	      (A + Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) (Units.mk0 f hf))).toNat = n}
    62	
    63	/-- **The base multiplicity of `T` relative to `A` at a closed point**: the minimum of
    64	`(A + div f)ₚ` over nonzero `f ∈ T`. -/
    65	noncomputable def Scheme.baseDivisorAt (T : Submodule K X.functionField)
    66	    (A : X.CurveDivisor) (p : {x : X // x ≠ genericPoint X}) : ℕ :=
    67	  sInf (Scheme.baseDivisorSet K T A p)
    68	
    69	lemma Scheme.baseDivisorSet_nonempty {T : Submodule K X.functionField}
    70	    (A : X.CurveDivisor) (hT : ∃ f ∈ T, f ≠ 0) (p : {x : X // x ≠ genericPoint X}) :
    71	    (Scheme.baseDivisorSet K T A p).Nonempty := by
    72	  obtain ⟨f, hfT, hf⟩ := hT
    73	  exact ⟨_, f, hfT, hf, rfl⟩
    74	
    75	/-! ## The assembled base divisor -/
    76	
    77	/-- **The base divisor `bd(T)` of a subspace `T` relative to `A`**: the Weil divisor of
    78	pointwise base multiplicities. Finitely supported because `0 ≤ bd(T)ₚ ≤ (A + div f₀)ₚ`
    79	for the chosen nonzero `f₀ ∈ T`. -/
    80	noncomputable def Scheme.baseDivisor (T : Submodule K X.functionField)
    81	    (A : X.CurveDivisor) (hT : ∃ f ∈ T, f ≠ 0) : X.CurveDivisor :=
    82	  Finsupp.onFinset
    83	    (toFinsupp (A + Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
    84	      (Units.mk0 hT.choose hT.choose_spec.2))).support
    85	    (fun p => (Scheme.baseDivisorAt K T A p : ℤ))
    86	    (fun p hp => by
    87	      rw [Finsupp.mem_support_iff]
    88	      intro hzero
    89	      apply hp
    90	      have hle : Scheme.baseDivisorAt K T A p
    91	          ≤ (coeffAt p.2 (A + Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
    92	              (Units.mk0 hT.choose hT.choose_spec.2))).toNat :=
    93	        Nat.sInf_le ⟨hT.choose, hT.choose_spec.1, hT.choose_spec.2, rfl⟩
    94	      have hc : coeffAt p.2 (A + Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
    95	          (Units.mk0 hT.choose hT.choose_spec.2)) = 0 := hzero
    96	      omega)
    97	
    98	/-- The pointwise value of the base divisor is the base multiplicity. -/
    99	lemma Scheme.coeffAt_baseDivisor {T : Submodule K X.functionField} {A : X.CurveDivisor}
   100	    (hT : ∃ f ∈ T, f ≠ 0) {x : X} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X) :
   101	    coeffAt hx (Scheme.baseDivisor K T A hT)
   102	      = (Scheme.baseDivisorAt K T A ⟨x, hx⟩ : ℤ) :=
   103	  rfl
   104	
   105	/-- **The base divisor is effective.** -/
   106	lemma Scheme.baseDivisor_nonneg {T : Submodule K X.functionField} {A : X.CurveDivisor}
   107	    (hT : ∃ f ∈ T, f ≠ 0) : 0 ≤ Scheme.baseDivisor K T A hT := by
   108	  refine CurveDivisor.le_iff_coeffAt.mpr (fun x hx => ?_)
   109	  rw [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_zero, Scheme.coeffAt_baseDivisor K hT hx]
   110	  positivity
   111	
   112	/-! ## The lower-bound and achiever properties -/
   113	
   114	/-- Under `T ⊆ H⁰(𝒪(A))`, the shifted divisor `A + div f` of a nonzero `f ∈ T` is
   115	effective at every closed point. -/
   116	lemma Scheme.coeffAt_add_divOf_nonneg {T : Submodule K X.functionField}
   117	    {A : X.CurveDivisor} (hTA : T ≤ divisorSections K A ⊤) {f : X.functionField}
   118	    (hfT : f ∈ T) (hf : f ≠ 0) {x : X} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X) :
   119	    0 ≤ coeffAt hx
   120	      (A + Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) (Units.mk0 f hf)) := by
   121	  have hmem := hTA hfT
   122	  rw [mem_divisorSections_top_iff K hf] at hmem
   123	  have h := CurveDivisor.le_iff_coeffAt.mp hmem x hx
   124	  rwa [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_zero] at h
   125	
   126	/-- **The lower-bound property of the base divisor**: `bd(T) ≤ A + div f` pointwise, for
   127	every nonzero `f ∈ T`. -/
   128	lemma Scheme.baseDivisorAt_le_coeffAt {T : Submodule K X.functionField}
   129	    {A : X.CurveDivisor} (hTA : T ≤ divisorSections K A ⊤) {f : X.functionField}
   130	    (hfT : f ∈ T) (hf : f ≠ 0) {x : X} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X) :
   131	    (Scheme.baseDivisorAt K T A ⟨x, hx⟩ : ℤ)
   132	      ≤ coeffAt hx
   133	          (A + Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) (Units.mk0 f hf)) := by
   134	  have h1 : Scheme.baseDivisorAt K T A ⟨x, hx⟩
   135	      ≤ (coeffAt hx
   136	          (A + Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) (Units.mk0 f hf))).toNat :=
   137	    Nat.sInf_le ⟨f, hfT, hf, rfl⟩
   138	  have h2 := Scheme.coeffAt_add_divOf_nonneg K hTA hfT hf hx
   139	  omega
   140	
   141	/-- **The achiever**: at every closed point, some nonzero `f ∈ T` attains the base
   142	multiplicity: `(A + div f)ₓ = bd(T)ₓ`. -/
   143	lemma Scheme.exists_coeffAt_eq_baseDivisorAt {T : Submodule K X.functionField}
   144	    {A : X.CurveDivisor} (hTA : T ≤ divisorSections K A ⊤) (hT : ∃ f ∈ T, f ≠ 0)
   145	    {x : X} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X) :
   146	    ∃ (f : X.functionField) (_ : f ∈ T) (hf : f ≠ 0),
   147	      coeffAt hx (A + Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) (Units.mk0 f hf))
   148	        = (Scheme.baseDivisorAt K T A ⟨x, hx⟩ : ℤ) := by
   149	  have hmem : Scheme.baseDivisorAt K T A ⟨x, hx⟩ ∈ Scheme.baseDivisorSet K T A ⟨x, hx⟩ :=
   150	    Nat.sInf_mem (Scheme.baseDivisorSet_nonempty K A hT ⟨x, hx⟩)
   151	  obtain ⟨f, hfT, hf, heq⟩ := hmem
   152	  refine ⟨f, hfT, hf, ?_⟩
   153	  have h2 := Scheme.coeffAt_add_divOf_nonneg K hTA hfT hf hx
   154	  omega
   155	
   156	/-! ## The normalization: `T ⊆ H⁰(𝒪(A − bd T))` with no residual base point -/
   157	
   158	/-- **The base-divisor normalization**: `T ⊆ H⁰(𝒪(A − bd T))` — every nonzero `f ∈ T`
   159	has `(A − bd T) + div f ≥ 0` because `bd(T)` is a pointwise minimum. -/
   160	theorem Scheme.le_divisorSections_sub_baseDivisor {T : Submodule K X.functionField}
   161	    {A : X.CurveDivisor} (hTA : T ≤ divisorSections K A ⊤) (hT : ∃ f ∈ T, f ≠ 0) :
   162	    T ≤ divisorSections K (A - Scheme.baseDivisor K T A hT) ⊤ := by
   163	  intro f hfT
   164	  by_cases hf : f = 0
   165	  · subst hf
   166	    exact Submodule.zero_mem _
   167	  · rw [mem_divisorSections_top_iff K hf]
   168	    refine CurveDivisor.le_iff_coeffAt.mpr (fun x hx => ?_)
   169	    rw [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_zero, CurveDivisor.coeffAt_add, CurveDivisor.coeffAt_sub,
   170	      Scheme.coeffAt_baseDivisor K hT hx]
   171	    have h4 := Scheme.baseDivisorAt_le_coeffAt K hTA hfT hf hx
   172	    rw [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_add] at h4
   173	    omega
   174	
   175	/-- **No residual base point** (the `hbpf` input of the bpf-span lemma): relative to the
   176	normalized divisor `A − bd T`, the subspace `T` has an exact-order element at every
   177	closed point: `((A − bd T) + div f)ₓ = 0`. -/
   178	theorem Scheme.exists_achiever_baseDivisor_sub {T : Submodule K X.functionField}
   179	    {A : X.CurveDivisor} (hTA : T ≤ divisorSections K A ⊤) (hT : ∃ f ∈ T, f ≠ 0)
   180	    {x : X} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X) :
   181	    ∃ (f : X.functionField) (_ : f ∈ T) (hf : f ≠ 0),
   182	      coeffAt hx ((A - Scheme.baseDivisor K T A hT)
   183	        + Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) (Units.mk0 f hf)) = 0 := by
   184	  obtain ⟨f, hfT, hf, heq⟩ := Scheme.exists_coeffAt_eq_baseDivisorAt K hTA hT hx
   185	  refine ⟨f, hfT, hf, ?_⟩
   186	  rw [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_add, CurveDivisor.coeffAt_sub,
   187	    Scheme.coeffAt_baseDivisor K hT hx]
   188	  rw [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_add] at heq
   189	  omega

    10	# Sections to divisors — the LocalEquations construction and the class law (DAT-A)
    11	
    12	Worksheet §2.2 step 2, made literal (`informal/spec-dat-a.md` §3): a global section of
    13	the DAT-1 glued sheaf **is** a matching family `(s_j)` with `s_i = g_{ij}·s_j`, so once
    14	its components are germ-regular (DAT-A2, `AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.SectionsToDivisors`)
    15	it is a `Scheme.LocalEquations` datum on the nose. The (1e) class law
    16	(`Cohomology/GluedSheafClass.lean`, landed while this brick was in flight) is consumed
    17	directly — the spec's `cocycleClassOn` seam is CLOSED, no interim class carrier exists:
    18	
    19	* `BasicOpenCocycleDatum.sectionLocalEquations` — the LocalEquations datum of a
    20	  germ-regular global section on **any** pointed cover subordinated to the pieces
    21	  (the (1e) subordination interface `𝒲, σ, hσ`): equations the restricted components
    22	  `D.component s (σ y)`, ratio witnesses the subordinated transition units
    23	  `gluedSubordUnit`;
    24	* `sectionLocalEquations_ratioUnit` — the ratio units are **exactly** the (restricted)
    25	  transition units of the cocycle (`ratioUnit_unique`); on the piece cover the
    26	  restriction is along `≤`-reflexivity, i.e. the units themselves;
    27	* `sectionLocalEquations_unitsCocycle` — the units cocycle of the constructed datum is
    28	  the (1e) subordinated cocycle `gluedSubordCocycle`;
    29	* **the class law** `sectionLocalEquations_picClass`:
    30	  `(D.sectionLocalEquations …).picClass = D.cechPicClass` — the divisor datum cut out
    31	  by a germ-regular section presents THE class of the datum's cocycle (the Abel
    32	  correspondence), through the landed `cechPicClass_eq_mk`. Naturality under
    33	  refinement/subordination-choice is the landed `gluedSubordCocycle_class_eq`; unit
    34	  rescalings and cover refinements of the constructed datum keep the class by the
    35	  landed `LocalEquations.picClass_rescale`/`picClass_restrict`;
    36	* `sectionLocalEquations_picClass_congr` — any two germ-regular sections on any two
    37	  subordinated covers cut divisors of the same class;
    38	* `sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular` — the A2-bundled wrapper on the canonical
    39	  pointed cover (`D.pointedCover`): a fibrewise-regular global section yields the
    40	  divisor datum outright, with class `D.cechPicClass` (`[IsNoetherianRing B]`).
    41	-/

    73	of a subordinated pointed cover: the matching relation of the glued family, restricted
    74	from `⊤ ⊓ Uᵢ ⊓ Uⱼ`. -/
    75	private lemma component_ratio_eq (y y' : relCurve C B) :
    76	    ((relCurve C B).presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left :
    77	        𝒲.opens y ⊓ 𝒲.opens y' ≤ 𝒲.opens y)).op).hom
    78	        ((relCurve C B).resHom (hσ y) (D.component s (σ y)))
    79	      = (gluedSubordUnit D.unit 𝒲 σ hσ y y' :
    80	            Γ(relCurve C B, 𝒲.opens y ⊓ 𝒲.opens y'))
    81	        * ((relCurve C B).presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right :
    82	            𝒲.opens y ⊓ 𝒲.opens y' ≤ 𝒲.opens y')).op).hom
    83	            ((relCurve C B).resHom (hσ y') (D.component s (σ y'))) := by
    84	  have hle : 𝒲.opens y ⊓ 𝒲.opens y'
    85	      ≤ ⊤ ⊓ D.pieces (σ y) ⊓ D.pieces (σ y') :=
    86	    le_inf (le_inf le_top (inf_le_left.trans (hσ y))) (inf_le_right.trans (hσ y'))
    87	  have key := congrArg ((relCurve C B).resHom hle) (s.property (σ y) (σ y'))

    89	  simp only [Scheme.resHom_resHom] at key

    91	      ((relCurve C B).resHom (hσ y) (D.component s (σ y)))
    92	    = (gluedSubordUnit D.unit 𝒲 σ hσ y y' :
    93	        Γ(relCurve C B, 𝒲.opens y ⊓ 𝒲.opens y'))
    94	      * (relCurve C B).resHom inf_le_right

   197	/-- **Fibrewise-nonzero sections cut divisors** (DAT-A + DAT-A2, bundled): over a

   202	    [IsNoetherianRing B]

   108	                (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk z) X.functionField c) := by

The proof uses the existing germ/trivialization bridge, so it remains valid after the noncanonical transported-window shift.
